proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D h hi
  have hCA : C -ᵥ A = (B -ᵥ A) + (D -ᵥ A) := by
    rw [h, vsub_add_vsub_cancel]
  have hDB : D -ᵥ B = (D -ᵥ A) - (B -ᵥ A) := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right D B A).symm
  rw [hCA, hDB, inner_add_left, inner_sub_right, inner_sub_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, real_inner_comm (B -ᵥ A) (D -ᵥ A)] at hi
  rw [dist_comm A B, dist_comm A D, dist_eq_norm_vsub V B A, dist_eq_norm_vsub V D A]
  have h3 : ‖B -ᵥ A‖ ^ 2 = ‖D -ᵥ A‖ ^ 2 := by linarith
  exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp h3
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D : P), B -ᵥ A = C -ᵥ D → inner ℝ (C -ᵥ A) (D -ᵥ B) = 0 → dist A B = dist A D
